patterns.note: Large, full-bleed project cards with embedded UI screenshots are presented in an alternating two-column layout, often with a gradient overlay or distinct background color.
A highly distinctive, blocky, almost pixelated display font is used for the main brand logo and large footer text, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for all other content.

The site primarily uses a very light, almost white background with a deep dark blue for primary text and interactive elements, punctuated by vibrant, multi-color gradients within project card backgrounds.

Upon scrolling, the initial hero content scrolls away, and two distinct call-to-action buttons appear and stick: a circular 'Book a call with Chris' button at the top center and a rectangular 'Book a call' button at the bottom right.
Client logos are displayed in a horizontal, scrollable carousel, indicating a large portfolio of partnerships.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, impactful headline and subtext, followed by a grid of client logos that scroll horizontally. Below this, project cards are presented with a mix of gradient overlays and embedded product UI screenshots, creating a rich visual showcase.

Scroll-triggered sticky elements are implemented for calls-to-action: a circular button with an avatar sticks to the top of the viewport, and a rectangular button sticks to the bottom-right. These likely use CSS position: sticky or a JavaScript-driven scroll listener.

The overall page structure uses generous vertical spacing between sections, creating an airy feel, while content within cards and text blocks maintains a balanced density. The detected animation tech (canvas, css-keyframes, rive) suggests potential for subtle background animations or interactive elements, though the primary scroll motion observed is the sticky CTA reveal.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold display headings (~4-5x body) with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, legible body text and labels, all using a clean sans-serif, except for the unique display font.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card corners, with some elements (like the display font) featuring sharp, angular edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical padding between major sections and a balanced density within content blocks and cards.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the use of a highly unique, blocky, almost pixelated display font for the brand's logo and large footer text, which provides a strong, memorable identity that contrasts sharply with the otherwise clean and modern sans-serif typography. This, combined with the large, illustrative project cards featuring embedded UI, creates a strong portfolio showcase.
